posts.t:
Ifmyante wrote: To take this seriously, we must watch not only our favourite instruments, but also their correlated pairs.

This gives us a better idea of when we should and shouldn't enter.

If say, USD/CAD is at a nice level, but CAD/YEN hasn't yet hit its target, we must wait for both of them to be in position.

I have about ten favourite pairs, but to trade them I'd need to watch perhaps double that amount

Or just use some composite currency indexes and save the headache

posts.t:
When we have an If/Then setup, we don't need PA for a RT entry. We
simply need to decide whether or not to wait for the very best price on
RT.

If it hits straight away, we have the very best possible R. If not, we
may miss decent decent swings within the forming flag while we wait.

اگر همان لحظه به آن بخورد، بهترین R ممکن را داریم. اگر نه، اگر صبر کنیم، ممکن است سوئینگ‌های خوبی را که هنگام شکل‌گیری فلگ رخ می‌دهد از دست بدهیم.
